notes: A protocol is a method's category — plots, provenance, accessing. Every Smalltalk since the 1970s organises a class by them, and this image has carried one on every method commit since 5.129.0 — settable when a method is saved and never reorganisable afterwards. The only way to move a method was to re-save it, which drags whatever is in the editor buffer along with it. A browser that can set a category once and never move it has a field, not a protocol.
